rawFindings.title: Parser initialization removed from constructor
rawFindings.explanation: The call to initialize the reply parser (this.reply_parser = create_parser(this);) was removed from the RedisClient constructor and moved to the create_stream function.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep the parser initialization in the constructor or ensure create_stream is called immediately after to avoid using an uninitialized parser in the short time after client creation.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Creating a new RedisClient and using the parser before create_stream is called will throw errors or behave incorrectly because reply_parser is not initialized yet.

rawFindings.title: Parser not reset before reconnection
rawFindings.explanation: The patch adds initialization of the parser during create_stream but does not reset or clear any existing parser state before reconnection. Without resetting the parser's internal buffer, partial or corrupted input may incorrectly accumulate across reconnects.
rawFindings.suggestion: Explicitly reset the parser's internal state (e.g., reply_parser.buffer) before re-initializing it upon stream creation or reconnection.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If the connection disconnects with partial data in parser, reconnecting will reuse the parser with leftover data causing parsing errors or crashes.
